<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: Echo Docking Bay''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス：エコー基地ドッキング・ベイ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここから他のドッキング・ベイへの輸送には１フォース消費する。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここから他のドッキング・ベイへの輸送には３フォース消費する。ここへの輸送には＋４フォース余分に消費する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Hoth-Echo-Docking-Bay-SWCA-100686.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: Echo Docking Bay.

'''Light Side:'''
Transit from here to another docking bay costs 1 Force.

'''Dark Side:'''
Transit from here to another docking bay costs 3 Force. Transit to here costs 4 extra Force.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese omits English “Your”.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: Echo Docking Bay]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
